May 19, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Gsa Capital Partners Llp increased its stake in Adobe Sys Inc (ADBE) by 41.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gsa Capital Partners Llp bought 8,101 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.17% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 27,476 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.82 million, up from 19,375 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gsa Capital Partners Llp who had been investing in Adobe Sys Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $117.25 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.52% or $1.24 during the last trading session, reaching $238.09. About 1.42 million shares traded. Adobe Systems Incorporated (NASDAQ:ADBE) has risen 66.71% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 55.16% the S&P500.
